newsitem.title: UK: NWE fuel oil steady amid quiet demand.
newsitem.headline: NWE fuel oil steady amid quiet demand.

text.p: Fuel oil remained steady on Wednesday amid continued quiet demand and lack of support from weaker crude.
High sulphur cracked fuel barges traded between $122-124 fob ARA, off $1 on Tuesday's levels in a quiet morning even though bunker demand was healthier.
"I wouldn't say it was bearish, rather that the market is not ready to go back to $128," said one barge trader.
Other dealers said the improved shipper interest could push barges higher although Russian straight-run material in tankage continued to lurk in the background, ready to limit any price push.
High sulphur cracked cargoes were steady at $116-118 fob NWE. Dealers said poorly offered material was matched by a lack of visible buying interest.
Low sulphur cracked cracked cargoes were also steady after being marked down slightly yesterday. Traders said $127-128 fob NWE reflected the physical market and paper numbers.
